verses.text: Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix wal icha tik: E masanil ex wetchonhab' israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.
Ha tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo nakión, manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh tas sch'ox sb'a t'a satcha'anh, icha syutej sb'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'.
Ha sb'eyb'al juntzanh nakión chi', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Sb'at suykot junok te yib' te' heb' t'a kaltak te', haxo junok winh nhikum te' snhikan te' yet' syamk'ab'.
Slajwi chi' syak'anoch k'een plata yet' k'een oro winh yelwanub'ok. Smak'anb'at slawuxal te' winh yet' k'een martillo yik stzatzb'i te', yik max el k'otnaj te'.

Ha juntzanh yechel chi', lajan icha xib'tanub'al nok' much t'a skal junok awb'en. Max yal-laj sloloni. Yowalil skuchji b'eyek'ok, yujto max yal-laj sb'eyi. Manh ex xiw t'a juntzanh chi', yujto malaj chukal, ma wach'il syak' t'a heb' anima, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan et'ok, yujto te niwan elk'ochi, te b'inajnak ach, syal uj smasanil.

Ach sReyal masanil nakión, ¿tom ay junok mach manh smojok xiw t'ayach? Smoj wal te niwan elk'och t'a masanil anima. Ha t'a skal heb' jelan yet' t'a skal heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj junokxo mach lajan et'ok.
Masanil heb' anima chi' malaj spensar heb', malaj sjelanil heb', max yal sk'ayb'aj jab'ok heb' yuj juntzanh yechel b'ob'il t'a te te' chi'.

Ha juntzanh yechel komon Dios chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' tenum k'een, nab'a plata, haton k'een ik'b'ilkot t'a Tarsis yet' k'een oro ik'b'ilkot t'a Ufaz. Ha k'apak k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak yilji yet' k'apak chakchak k'apak ayoch spichulok. Masanil juntzanh chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' anima jelan spensar sb'oan tastak.

Axo Jehová, haton Dios pitzan, Dios t'a wal yel, Rey t'a junelnhej. Ayik skot yowal, tz'ib'xi wal lum lum tik yuj. Maxtzak yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a yichanh yowal sk'ol Jehová chi'.
Ex wetisraelal, alek t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il icha tik: Ha juntzanh komon Dios, manhok b'oannak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik, ol satel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, manhxa junok ol kanok, xe chi.
Ha Jehová b'oannak lum lum tik yet' spoder, a yet' sjelanil sb'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Anheja' yet' sjelanil chi' sb'onak pax satcha'anh.

Ayik tz'awaj Jehová chi', tz'ib'xik'e ha ha' t'a satcha'anh, sk'e waan asun t'a chaanh yuj masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik. Tz'ek' kopoljok lheb'lon t'a skal niwak yaxnhab' yuj, sjakanelta ik' b'aj molan yuj.

Masanil heb' anima tz'ak'anoch komon Dios yipok sk'ool, malaj spensar heb', malaj tas yojtak heb'. Masanil heb' tenum k'een, tz'ak'ji q'uixwelal heb' yuj juntzanh yechel sb'o chi'. Ha juntzanh yechel sb'o heb' chi', malaj yelk'ochi, malaj spixan.
Ha juntzanh yechel chi', malaj jab'ok yopisio, smoj wal stzetzaji. Ayik ol jawok yaelal yuj Jehová, ol satelok.
Te ch'ok yel ko Diosal a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ha b'oannak masanil tasi, ix onh sik'anpaxel a onh israel onh tik yik tzonh ochkan yikok. Ha sb'i, haton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Ex aj Jerusalén, oyb'ilxok'e ko chonhab' yuj heb' ajk'ool, molb'ejek masanil he k'ael.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ha tiknaik ol in molkot yaelal t'a he patik masanto ol yal eyamchaji. Masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol ex in pechb'at t'a najat, icha tz'aj sjuljib'at junok k'een k'een yet' ch'anh mejmeech, xchi.
Ix walan a in Jeremías in tik: Ob'iltak in, wan wab'an syail. Ha wechen tik malaj yanhal. Ha jun yaelal tik wik yaji yuj chi' ol wak' techajok.
Toxo ix em lanhnaj ko pat, icha mantiado st'inhchaj sch'anhal. Toxo ix cham heb' kuninal, ix onh yaktejkan heb', yuj chi' manhxa mach skolwaj ket'ok yik slich'ank'e jab'ok kenhul.
Ha heb' yilumal ko chonhab', malaj spensar heb'. Max sk'an sjelanil heb' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' onh saklemb'at icha nok' kalnel.

Ab'ek wal sjawi jun ab'ix tik. Ay jun chonhab' skot t'a stojolal norte nhilili sk'anh skoti. Ha jun chi' ol ak'ankanoch juntzanh ko chonhab' tik tzinan lumal. Axonhej nok' niwak okes ol kajnajkan t'ay.
Mamin Jehová, wojtak sik'lab'il to a onh anima onh tik manh kojtakok tas ol aj kelk'ochi. Max nachaj kuj tastak sjawi t'a kichanh.
Ak' ko yaelal icha wal t'a stojolal, palta manhokab' yet' yowal a k'ool yik max onh a sateli.

Hak'uem yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il, juntzanh chonhab' to manh ach ojtannakok, juntzanh chonhab' max yal sb'a t'ayach, yujto ix satel ko chonhab' heb' a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Junelnhej ix onh satel heb'. Ix laj yak'kan tzinan ko chonhab' tik heb', xin chi.
